facts.text: I try not to think about death too much.
Sometimes it is hard not to think about death.
I think someday my consciousness will simply cease to exist.
I think making the most of our time here is important.
I think spending quality time with family and friends makes life meaningful.
I think traveling to new places makes life meaningful.
I think pursuing my passions makes life meaningful.

keyphrases: quality time with family and friends
